actions.mechanism: A durable per-document format prevents a global flag from making previously readable documents unreadable.
actions.implementation: Keep existing documents legacy-format. Allow new-format creation only when the flag is enabled and the creator declares required capabilities; retain legacy creation.
actions.check: With mixed-version collaborators, enable the flag and edit an existing document; verify the old client still reads every committed revision.
actions.risk: Legacy documents cannot accept features requiring the new format.

actions.action: Validate capabilities separately for each client session
actions.mechanism: Opening requires the document’s capabilities, not an account-wide assumption based on another client or the rollout flag.
actions.implementation: Check declared capabilities server-side on create, open, and write. Key capability caches by session and declaration revision; reject mismatches before returning document payloads.
actions.check: Cache new-client capabilities, then access through an old-client session on the same account; verify legacy reads succeed and new-format access fails safely.
actions.risk: Declarations cannot prove actual parser support; incorrectly declaring clients remain a risk.

actions.action: Roll back creation without disabling existing documents
actions.mechanism: Separate creation permission from format recognition so disabling rollout never reinterprets or deletes existing content.
actions.implementation: On rollback, reject new-format creation and writes, retain stored bytes and decoder support, and allow capable clients read-only access to existing new-format documents.
actions.check: Create a new-format document, roll back, and verify unchanged content, successful capable-client reads, rejected writes, and continued old-client access to legacy documents.
actions.risk: Operational rollback must retain compatible read infrastructure.

actions.action: Offer explicit forks instead of in-place conversion
actions.mechanism: A separate new-format document lets capable users adopt new features without replacing the legacy document shared with old clients.
actions.implementation: Provide an explicit fork operation under creation eligibility checks. Preserve the source, record provenance, and label both documents as independent with no automatic synchronization.
actions.check: Fork a shared legacy document, add new-only content, and verify old collaborators still read the untouched source; reject unsupported merges explicitly.
actions.risk: Independent branches diverge; users must understand which document contains later work.
